# storybranch

> Alpha open-source visual testing for Storybook 10+: capture stories as PNGs, pixel-diff against baselines in git, review locally. Not on npm yet — clone the repo and run the CLI from the package that owns Storybook (`package.json` + `.storybook/`), or pass `--cwd`.

Storybook must already be running at a URL Chromium can reach. Chromatic `modes` or `viewports` on a story become extra snapshots; both on one story is an error.

`storybranch test --url <storybook>` exits **1** when a snapshot needs attention. Failure lines: `missing baseline <file.png>`, `pixels <file.png>`, `size <file.png>`, `stale <file.png>`. A clean run prints `ok`. Inventory: `.storybranch/report.json` under that package. The **first run** exits 1 with `missing baseline` for every shot — that is the baseline set, not a broken install. Monorepos: one `.storybranch/` per Storybook package; use `--cwd` when not cd’d into the app.

Commit only that package’s `.storybranch/baseline/`. Ignore `actual/`, `diff/`, and `report.json`. Run `approve` only when asked to accept shots. `review` and `--open` are for a person.

Until publish: `bun /path/to/storybranch/apps/cli/src/cli.ts`. After publish: `bunx storybranch`. Install: clone [github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch), `bun install`, `bunx playwright install chromium`, `bun run build`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch#readme): install, usage, CI, monorepo development
- [Quick start & For agents](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch#quick-start): clone path, exit codes, AGENTS.md snippet
- [Agent snippet on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/#agents): copy-paste `.gitignore` and AGENTS.md for your Storybook app
- [How it works on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/#how): three-command workflow
